summary_zh: 本页为绘本封面，标题为《抢救机器狗》，属于《汪汪队立大功儿童安全救援故事书》系列，由美国尼克儿童频道著，安东尼译，天地出版社出版。画面中展示了角色小砾和机器狗，以及飞行中的Skye。

title_en: Paw Patrol: Rescue the Robot Dog
page_text_ocr_zh:
莱德第一次展示他新发明的机器狗罗博。
“罗博，坐下！”莱德命令道。
“哇，太酷了！”天天赞叹道。

莱德说：“我刚刚把它做出来。现在，
让我们试试挖洞吧！”

莱德刚按下按钮，机器狗罗博就飞快
地向地底下钻去。

莱德盯着罗博挖出的洞说：“它这是
去哪儿了啊？”
page_text_en:
Ryder showed off his newly invented robot dog, Robo for the first time.
"Robo, sit!" Ryder commanded.
"Wow, that's so cool!"天天 exclaimed.

Ryder said, "I just finished making it. Now, let's try digging a hole!"

Ryder pressed the button, and the robot dog Robo quickly dug down into the ground.

Ryder stared at the hole Robo dug and said, "Where is it going?"
summary_zh: 莱德向伙伴们展示他新发明的机器狗罗博，命令它坐下并尝试挖洞，罗博迅速钻入地下，莱德对此感到疑惑。

title_en: Paw Patrol: Rescue the Robot Dog
page_text_ocr_zh:
罗博从路马的狗狗屋地下钻出来，
把正在睡觉的路马吓了一跳呢！

“哇，你是从哪儿冒出来的呀？”路马吃惊地问道。

莱德气喘吁吁地赶来了，说：“不好意思，路马，我想你已经见过机器狗罗博了。接下来，我们让罗博试飞吧！”

话音刚落，罗博的爪子就变成了四支小火箭，它“嗖”的一声飞向空中。

“哇！”所有的人都惊呼起来。

“它的速度真快啊！”莱德说。
page_text_en:
Robo钻出了路马的狗狗屋地下，
scaring the sleeping Zuma!

"Wow, where did you come from?" Zuma asked, surprised.

Ryder arrived, panting, and said, "Sorry, Zuma, I think you've already met robot dog Robo. Next, let's try flying Robo!"

As soon as he finished speaking, Robo's paws turned into four small rockets, and with a "whoosh," it flew into the air.

"Wow!" everyone exclaimed.

"It's so fast!" Ryder said.
summary_zh: 罗博从路马的狗狗屋地下钻出，吓到了正在睡觉的路马。莱德赶到后解释并决定让罗博试飞，罗博随即启动火箭爪飞向空中，引得众人惊叹。

title_en: Paw Patrol: Rescue the Robot Dog
page_text_ocr_zh:
各就各位，预备——
我没事——
毛毛不服气地说：“没有机器
会比我跑得快！让我们来比赛吧！”
阿奇让毛毛和机器狗罗博并排
站到起跑线上，用扩音器喊道：“各
就各位，预备，跑！”
跑！
毛毛和罗博开始赛跑了。
本来是毛毛领先，可是他突
然被一段木头给绊倒了。
在穿过树洞时，又发生
了意外。“我被卡住了！”
毛毛大声喊道。
page_text_en:
Ready, set——
I'm fine——
Mao Mao said不服气地: “No machine can run faster than me! Let’s have a race!”
Chase lined Mao Mao and robot dog Robo side by side at the starting line and shouted through the megaphone: “Ready, set, go!”
Go!
Mao Mao and Robo started the race.
Mao Mao was leading at first, but then he suddenly tripped over a piece of wood.
While passing through the tree trunk, another accident happened. “I’m stuck!” Mao Mao shouted loudly.
summary_zh: 毛毛不服气机器狗罗博的速度，提出比赛。阿奇组织比赛后，毛毛在奔跑中被木头绊倒，随后在穿过树洞时被卡住，大声呼救。

title_en: Paw Patrol: Rescue the Robot Dog
page_text_ocr_zh:
“坚持住！”莱德一边喊，一边按下机器狗控制器上的“涡轮启动”键。
机器狗像旋风一样飞快地钻进树洞，把毛毛推了出来。
冲出树洞的毛毛撞到了莱德，莱德碰巧一屁股坐在机器狗身上。
哎——
“哦，不！机器狗的天线坏了！”毛毛叫道。
机器狗一边抽搐着，一边发出嗡嗡声。莱德正想关闭机器狗，机器狗却突然挖了一个地道，消失了！
page_text_en:
"Hold on!" Ryder shouted, pressing the "Turbo Start" button on the robot dog's controller.
The robot dog zoomed into the tree hole like a whirlwind, pushing Marshall out.
Marshall, emerging from the hole, bumped into Ryder, who happened to sit right on top of the robot dog.
Ah——
"Oh no! The robot dog's antenna is broken!" Marshall cried.
The robot dog twitched and buzzed. As Ryder tried to turn it off, the robot dog suddenly dug a tunnel and disappeared!
summary_zh: 毛毛被卡在树洞后，莱德操控机器狗将其救出，但机器狗在莱德坐上后天线损坏，抽搐并突然钻入地下消失。

title_en: Paw Patrol: Rescue the Robot Dog
page_text_ocr_zh:
古威市长急忙呼叫：“莱德，快来帮忙！不知道谁的宠物狗发疯了！”
莱德回答说：“那是我的机器狗！它突然失控了，我们会处理好的。”
“汪汪队，马上到塔台集合！”莱德立刻召集汪汪队。
机器狗罗博从中央大街的地面钻了出来。
罗博直直地冲向了波特先生的水果摊，波特先生来不及躲闪，一下子把古威市长绊倒在地上，到处都成了一团糟。
page_text_en:
Mayor Goodway urgently called out, “Ryder, come help! I don’t know whose pet dog has gone crazy!”
Ryder replied, “That’s my robot dog! It’s suddenly lost control, but we’ll handle it.”
“Pups, report to the tower immediately!” Ryder quickly called the Paw Patrol.
The robot dog Robo emerged from the ground on Central Street.
Robo charged straight toward Mr. Porter’s fruit stand. Mr. Porter didn’t have time to dodge, and Robo knocked Mayor Goodway to the ground, making a complete mess everywhere.
summary_zh: 机器狗罗博失控后从地下钻出，冲向波特先生的水果摊，撞倒了古威市长，造成混乱。莱德接到求助后召集汪汪队准备处理危机。

title_en: Paw Patrol: Rescue the Robot Dog
page_text_ocr_zh:
狗狗们迅速向塔台赶去，准备行动。
莱德说：“我们必须在罗博造成更大
混乱之前阻止它！如果能切断它的电源，
我就能想办法修好它。”
“天天，用你的变焦探测镜来确定它
的位置。灰灰，我需要你做一个能抓住它
的工具。”
“开启空中巡查！”天天叫道。
“旧物别丢掉，还有大用处。”灰灰
叫道。
莱德说：“剩下的队员，马上去清理
罗博弄坏的物品！行动起来！”
page_text_en:
The pups quickly head to the Lookout to prepare for action.
Ryder says, "We must stop Robo before it causes more chaos! If I can cut off its power, I can figure out how to fix it."
"Chase, use your zoom lens to locate it. Rocky, I need you to make a tool that can grab it."
"Activating aerial patrol!" Chase calls out.
"Don't throw away old things, they're still useful!" Rocky calls out.
Ryder says, "The rest of the team, go clean up the mess Robo made! Let's go!"
summary_zh: 莱德在塔台指挥汪汪队应对失控的机器狗罗博，命令天天定位、灰灰制作工具，并安排其他队员清理现场。

title_en: Paw Patrol: Rescue the Robot Dog
page_text_ocr_zh:
天天驾驶着直升机在空中仔细地搜寻着罗博。
“罗博正在往水塔处冲去！”天天报告说。
罗博冲破水塔，又朝着宠物店撞去。
凯蒂和莉莉为了躲避它，竟然跳到了浴缸里。
“我想它不喜欢走狗狗专用门。”凯蒂心想。
撞击！
page_text_en:
TayTay is flying her helicopter through the sky, carefully searching for Robo.
"Robo is heading straight for the water tower!" TayTay reports.
Robo crashes through the water tower and then heads toward the pet store.
Katie and Lily jump into the bathtub to avoid it.
"I think it doesn't like using the doggy door," Katie thinks.
Crash!
summary_zh: 天天驾驶直升机搜寻失控的机器狗罗博，发现它正冲向水塔。罗博撞破水塔后冲向宠物店，凯蒂和莉莉为躲避它跳进浴缸，凯蒂心想它可能不喜欢走狗狗专用门，随后发生撞击。

title_en: Paw Patrol: Rescue the Robot Dog
page_text_ocr_zh:
小砾和路马正在清理中央大街。
“只剩下这一个好西瓜了，波特先生。”小砾说道。
波特先生说，“剩一个也不错！谢谢大家的帮忙。”
就在这时，罗博突然出现了，又把他们全都撞倒在地上。
最后一个西瓜也没保住，小砾无奈地叹了口气。
page_text_en:
Rubble and Zuma were cleaning Central Street.
"There's only one good watermelon left, Mr. Porter," Rubble said.
Mr. Porter said, "One is still fine! Thank you all for your help."
Just then, Robo suddenly appeared and knocked them all to the ground.
The last watermelon was lost too. Rubble sighed helplessly.
summary_zh: 小砾和路马正在清理中央大街的水果摊，只剩下一个西瓜时，失控的机器狗罗博突然出现，撞倒了所有人并撞坏了最后一个西瓜，小砾无奈叹息。

title_en: Paw Patrol: Rescue the Robot Dog
page_text_ocr_zh:
这时，灰灰正在做一个能抓住机器狗的磁铁装置。“马上就好了！”灰灰忙忙地说。

天天通过头盔对讲机呼叫莱德：“莱德，你的机器狗正朝我冲来！

莱德说：“你能把它引向灰灰的卡车那边吗？

“我会竭尽全力的！”天天说完，避开了直冲而来的机器狗。
page_text_en:
At this moment, Rocky is making a magnetic device to catch the robot dog. "It'll be ready soon!" Rocky says hurriedly.

Skye calls Ryder through her helmet radio: "Ryder, your robot dog is rushing toward me!"

Ryder says: "Can you lead it toward Rocky's truck?"

"I'll do my best!" Skye says, then dodges the robot dog rushing straight at her.
summary_zh: 灰灰正在制作磁铁装置捕捉失控的机器狗，同时天天在空中与莱德沟通，试图将机器狗引向灰灰的卡车，并成功躲避了它的冲撞。

title_en: Paw Patrol: Rescue the Robot Dog
page_text_ocr_zh:
天天将机器狗引向莱德和灰灰。
灰灰启动了磁铁装置，U型磁铁飞上天空，牢牢地吸住了机器狗。
莱德说：“干得漂亮，灰灰！该你上场了，天天！”
天天降下直升机的挂钩，抓牢了磁铁，大声喊道：“机器狗狗回家啦！”
page_text_en:
Skye guided the robot dog toward Ryder and Rocky.
Rocky activated the magnet device; the U-shaped magnet flew into the sky and firmly attached to the robot dog.
Ryder said, “Great job, Rocky! Now it’s your turn, Skye!”
Skye lowered the helicopter’s hook, secured the magnet, and shouted, “Robot dog, go home!”
summary_zh: 灰灰启动磁铁装置吸住失控的机器狗，天天驾驶直升机用挂钩抓住磁铁，将机器狗带离危险区域。

title_en: Paw Patrol: Rescue the Robot Dog
page_text_ocr_zh:
天天把机器狗放在波特先生家的小院里。刚落到地面上，机器狗又想逃，莱德立马关掉了它的电源。
“我想它得重新大修了。”莱德有些难过。
灰灰说：“别难过，莱德！我有一截旧天线可以给你用。”
莱德给机器狗换上天线，重新启动它。
page_text_en:
Tian Tian placed the robot dog in Mr. Porter's small yard. As soon as it landed, the robot dog tried to escape again, so Ryder immediately turned off its power.
"I think it needs a major repair," Ryder said sadly.
Gray said, "Don't be sad, Ryder! I have an old antenna I can give you."
Ryder put the new antenna on the robot dog and restarted it.
summary_zh: 莱德将失控的机器狗带到波特先生家的小院，关掉电源后感到难过，灰灰主动提供旧天线，莱德为机器狗更换天线并重新启动它。

title_en: Paw Patrol: Rescue the Robot Dog
page_text_ocr_zh:
机器狗恢复正常啦！
“谢谢你，灰灰！谢谢狗狗们！没有你们，我可搞不定它。”莱德说。
“哈哈，只要你有需要，莱德——”灰灰说。
“就呼叫汪汪队！”狗狗们一起说道。
“你们真是太棒啦！”莱德开心地说。
page_text_en:
The robot dog is back to normal!
"Thank you, Rocky! Thank you, pups! Without you, I couldn't have handled it," Ryder said.
"Ha ha, whenever you need me, Ryder—" Rocky said.
"Just call Paw Patrol!" the pups said together.
"You guys are amazing!" Ryder said happily.
summary_zh: 机器狗被成功修复并恢复正常，莱德感谢灰灰和汪汪队的协助，狗狗们齐声回应‘就呼叫汪汪队！’，莱德称赞他们表现很棒。
